title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: more indicator variants and larger detection groups
summary: The limits, licensing and documented controls are supported, and the briefing correctly reports conflicting Microsoft limits pages. However, its claim that policy configuration is limited to administrator role groups overlooks enabled inline alert customization, which lets analysts and investigators change policy thresholds and disable indicators. Narrow that statement rather than treating administrator membership as the complete boundary on policy changes.
